version.author: TwelveTake Studios
version.changelog: This release needs the 1.11.0 bridge. After you update, run uvx twelvetake-reaper-mcp@1.11.0 --install-bridge, or twelvetake-reaper-mcp --install-bridge if you installed with pip. If REAPER is running the 1.7.8 bridge or later, you don't have to do anything in REAPER. If you installed the bridge with ReaPack, synchronize your packages instead. Until the bridge is updated, every tool answers with what to do. Added: - find_silence finds the quiet stretches in an item's audio, or in every audio item on a track: where nothing peaks above threshold_db (-40 dBFS unless you say otherwise) for at least min_length_s (0.5 s). Each stretch comes back in project seconds with its edges measured to the sample, and says whether it touches the item's start or end, so you can split or trim exactly on it. Take offset, play rate, reversed takes and looped items are mapped; MIDI and empty items are listed as skipped. It reads the audio before item and take volume, fades and FX, and adds no undo step.
